newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel barges hit new 5 year highs.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel barges hit new 5 year highs.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil barges reached fresh five year highs on Friday on good bunker demand, high futures prices and very tight supply, traders said.
Barges traded early at $120 and $121 fob ARA althought the offer then slipped back to $120, with bids $1 lower. Soaring U.S. bunker prices have also added support.
High sulphur cargoes were still tight.
Some dealers felt that offers from a trader late on Thursday at $115 cif NWE were not realistic, given that October cif cargo swap numbers were around $3 higher.
An Italian refiner bought 25,000 tonnes of M-40 on Thursday as a part cargo at $4.50 over the quoted cif high, cif northwestern Italy. The seller was thought to be a trader.
The same refiner held an M-100 cargo, which would be suitable for ENEL or for Lebanon, and discussion for this piece was heard around the quoted low sulphur cif high +$3.
Other straight-run cargoes available in the Med include Egyptian and other Russian cargoes. "Some of these Russians may have a problem finding homes," one trader said.
Low sulphur swaps were around $1 firmer.
